title: Dapp Store
tagline: DappStore that helps user easily access and manage frequently used mobile and web dapps
description:
This project leverages DappStoreKit sdk by polygon to give mobile users a native interface do install, update and manage various dapp apks as well as access frequently used dapps with native webview support which connects the wallet via Wallet Connect.

Users can search, update all dapps at once. Unified Wallet support lets them connect to wallet connect once instead of connecting for every dapp.
how_its_made:
This project is built on flutter and uses DappStoreKit Sdk by polygon, wallet connect flutter SDK to connect to wallet, and webview for accessing web only dapps. It runs on android only for now but in future can be made multiplatform to support android, ios and desktop.
